title: 30A Beach House Stillwater Cottage Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A beach house rental, Stillwater Cottage, located in Seacrest, FL is a 2 bedroom, 3 bathroom 30A vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. FREE ROUND OF GOLF EACH DAY OF YOUR STAY AND MORE!
description_expanded: Description Description 30A beach house rental, Stillwater Cottage, located in Seacrest, FL is a 2 bedroom, 3 bathroom 30A vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. FREE ROUND OF GOLF EACH DAY OF YOUR STAY AND MORE! Right next to Rosemary and Alys Beach - 5 minute or less walk to your fav shops! Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES * Gulf View Beach House * Large Living Area * Fully Equipped Kitchen w/Breakfast Bar * Dining Area * Master Bedroom w/King Bed * Private Balcony Access from Master Bedroom * Private Master Bathroom * 2nd Bedroom w/Bunk Bed (Queen over Queen) * 2 Additional Bathrooms * Full Size Washer/Dryer * FREE Wi-Fi * Seacrest Beach - Southside of 30A (Beachside) * Sleeps 4-6 30A Beach Access Points ABOUT 30A BEACH HOUSE - STILLWATER COTTAGE - SEACREST, FLORIDA Villas at Sunset Beach is located in Seacrest, FL and nestled between Alys Beach & Rosemary on the beachside of 30A. This location is fantastic and within steps to the beach. Guests will enjoy easy access to the beach, community gulf front pool along with convenient access to family friendlly restaurants and shopping. COMMUNITY AMENITIES GULF FRONT COMMUNITY GULF FRONT POOL (Heated Seasonally) COMMUNITY GAS GRILL OUTDOOR SHOWER / SAND MANAGEMENT PRIVATE BEACH ACCESS ON PROPERTY Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read more
